name: Gitee Open API
tagline: China-focused Git hosting REST API for repos, issues, PRs, and enterprises
description: Gitee Open API (v5) is the public REST interface for Gitee, a major China-focused Git hosting platform. It covers repositories, issues, pull requests, users, organizations, and enterprise features as a regional alternative to GitHub. Developers authenticate primarily with OAuth2 or personal access tokens and call HTTPS endpoints under gitee.com/api/v5.

auth.details: OAuth2 access tokens or personal access tokens (private_token query param or Authorization: token header); self-serve app registration at gitee.com

use_cases: list a user's public repositories on Gitee
create or update an issue on a Gitee repo
fetch pull request details and comments
search or list enterprise organization members
get file contents or commit history for a repo
